title: Man overboard: how to get someone back on board
lead: Prevention comes first, but every crew member should know the drill: what to do in the first seconds, when to call for help, how to return under engine or sail, and how to lift the person aboard.
description: Man overboard for yacht crews: prevention, the first seconds, when to send a Mayday, recovery under engine or sail, and getting the person back aboard safely.
summary: Clip on, wear a lifejacket and keep one hand for the boat.
Shout, throw the lifebuoy and danbuoy, point and press MOB.
Under engine, check for lines in the water and keep the propeller away from the person.
Under sail, use the quick-stop or reach-tack-reach, with a final approach on a close reach.
